channel.title: Rewire News Group - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Rewire News Group (rewirenewsgroup.com)

item.title: Wyoming Passes Near-Total Abortion Ban (Updated)
item.description: Plus, gender-affirming surgery blocked from West Virginia Medicaid and Trump comments tank Tylenol prescriptions for pregnant people.

item.title: Mississippi leads the nation in gun deaths among those who are pregnant and postpartum
item.description: Mississippi has become a hotspot for these deaths in large part because of lax gun laws and restrictive abortion access, both of which have been proven to increase violence against pregnant women.

item.title: Queer Muslims Find Community Through Ramadan
item.description: New York’s LGBT Center hosts its tenth annual queer iftar.

item.title: Washington Law Will Make It Easier for State to Distribute its Abortion Pill Stockpile
item.description: The newly-passed legislation makes it easier for the government to use or exchange soon-to-expire abortion drugs.

item.title: Black Women Deserve Answers About the Chemicals in Braiding Hair: Opinion
item.description: A new report found high lead levels in both synthetic and human braiding hair. It’s unclear how toxic these products are to users—but it shouldn’t be so hard to get basic information about our health.

item.title: Some Endometriosis Patients Are Changing Their Diets to Manage Symptoms
item.description: Endometriosis is underresearched and underdiagnosed. Providers and patients alike are trying a more holistic approach—but does it work?

item.title: Georgia Woman Charged With Murder in Apparent Self-Managed Abortion
item.description: Plus, Title X funding recipients scramble to renew family planning grants and vaccine guidelines get rebuked in federal court.

item.title: Detained pregnant people are entitled to full medical care. They say it’s not happening
item.description: Through interviews and a new report, a clearer picture of what is happening with prenatal care in immigration facilities is emerging as allegations are piling up.

item.title: Immigrants Survivors of Domestic Abuse Find Refuge and Community at Brooklyn Church
item.description: Latina women escaping domestic violence visit Bethlehem Lutheran Church’s Healing Center for resources and community.

item.title: Contraception Services Dropped After ‘Defunding’ Provision Hit Clinics
item.description: Planned Parenthood closed 20 clinics in the months since the July 2025 budget reconciliation bill cut off Medicaid funding to some reproductive health-care clinics.
